scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_full123", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="", description="API access payment required", digest="sha-256=X48E9qOokqqrvdts8nOJRJN3OWDUoyWxBf7kbu9DBPE=", expires="2026-01-29T12:05:00Z"

scenarios.name: empty_request
scenarios.description: Challenge with empty request object
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_empty", realm="test.example.com", method="tempo", intent="authorize", request="e30"

scenarios.name: nested_request
scenarios.description: Challenge with nested objects in request
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_nested", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="stream", request=""

scenarios.name: unescaped_quotes_in_description
scenarios.description: Unescaped quotes in description value — parsers truncate at quote boundary, remaining text is ignored
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_special", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="eyJhbW91bnQiOiIxMDAifQ", description="Payment for "Premium" service — 50% off!"

scenarios.name: escaped_quotes_in_description
scenarios.description: Escaped quoted-string values preserve embedded quotes
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_escaped", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30", description="Pay \"premium\" API"

scenarios.name: escaped_backslashes_in_description
scenarios.description: Escaped quoted-string values preserve literal backslashes
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_backslash", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30", description="Path C:\\tempo\\api"

scenarios.name: unicode_bmp_escapes
scenarios.description: Unicode above Latin-1 is serialized as uXXXX escapes and restored while parsing
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_unicode_bmp", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30", description="Payment \u2014 coffee \u2615"

scenarios.name: unicode_surrogate_pair
scenarios.description: A UTF-16 surrogate pair in a quoted-string is restored as one astral character
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_unicode_astral", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30", description="Pay with \ud83d\ude00"

scenarios.name: unicode_escape_in_realm
scenarios.description: Unicode escapes are decoded in binding-sensitive realm values, not only descriptions
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_unicode_realm", realm="merchant\u2014api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30"

scenarios.name: literal_unicode_escape
scenarios.description: A doubled backslash preserves literal uXXXX text instead of decoding it
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_unicode_literal", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30", description="literal \\u2014"

scenarios.name: truncated_unicode_escape
scenarios.description: A truncated u escape follows ordinary quoted-pair semantics
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_unicode_short", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30", description="short \u12 tail"

scenarios.name: unicode_ascii_escape
scenarios.description: A valid uXXXX escape below Latin-1 is decoded consistently with mppx
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_unicode_ascii", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30", description="ascii \u0061"

scenarios.name: raw_latin1_quoted_string
scenarios.description: Raw Latin-1 text remains intact when parsing a quoted-string
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_latin1", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30", description="café naïve"

scenarios.name: extended_method_identifier
scenarios.description: Method identifiers accept mppx extension characters after the initial lowercase letter
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_method_extension", realm="api.example.com", method="a1:b_2-c", intent="charge", request="e30"

scenarios.name: error_crlf_in_description_format
scenarios.description: Rejects CRLF in quoted-string values during formatting

scenarios.name: error_empty_id_format
scenarios.description: Rejects challenge object with empty id during formatting

scenarios.name: payment_keyword_in_quoted_realm
scenarios.description: The word 'Payment' inside a quoted parameter value must not be mistaken for a second auth scheme
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_qp_realm", realm="contact Payment support", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30"

scenarios.name: payment_keyword_in_quoted_description
scenarios.description: A quoted description containing 'Payment' is parsed as an opaque value, not a scheme boundary
scenarios.wire: Payment id="ch_qp_desc", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30", description="Pay with the Payment scheme"

scenarios.name: adversarial_unclosed_quoted_extension
scenarios.description: Malformed quoted extension auth-param with many escapes is ignored without pathological parser backtracking

wire.prefix: Payment id="ch_redos", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="e30", fuzz="

wire.prefix: Payment id="ch_oversized", realm="api.example.com", method="tempo", intent="charge", request="eyJwYWRkaW5nIjoi

scenarios.description: Rejects challenge missing required intent field
scenarios.wire: Payment id="abc", realm="api", method="tempo", request="e30"

scenarios.name: whitespace_tolerance
scenarios.description: Extra whitespace around separators is tolerated

scenarios.name: case_insensitive_scheme
